verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata has an Evidence Library with create, update and version API endpoints. A community member also reports that users can upload screenshots of settings periodically instead of running the agent. Neither source documents the workflow this story asks for: owners, due dates, renewal reminders or expiry tracking on manual artifacts. Storing manual evidence is adjacent to that workflow, not the workflow itself.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact
